set.body:
Source: 2026-07-23 full-codebase review supplied by the user.

Objective:
Close the correctness, wire-compatibility, type-discipline, performance, and publication gaps identified after the initial P6 slices. Preserve the existing strengths: AcceptanceUnknown reconciliation, bounded evidence, command-sourced managed state, argv-only Slurm invocation, atomic result publication, non-authoritative observability, and local/SSH conformance.

Scope:
- Cancellation safety at durable managed-state and dispatch seams.
- Agent protocol isolation, owned codecs, and honest frame budgets.
- Correct Slurm accounting/environment/SSH/worker behavior on messy systems.
- Efficient journal event polling and resilient text parsing.
- Completed Scala 3 type discipline, codec laws, and removal or completion of inert abstractions.
- Atomic filesystem staging plus a publishable, documented Scala 3.7.4 library surface.

Completion rule:
This epic remains open until every child remediation item is closed with focused regression evidence and the Scala 3.7.4 local gate is green. External real-site evidence remains tracked by P5.
set.title: P6f: Remediate full-codebase review blockers
